theorems.name: Submission.dorag_tes_gah_mult_one_le_hausdorff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (B : Set (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet B → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ B → R.mult x = 1) → R.measure.restrict B ≤ (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict B ∧ ∀ (A : Set (Euclid P)) (h : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), A ⊆ B → (∫⁻ x in A, h x ∂R.measure) ≤ ∫⁻ x in A, h x ∂μHE[n]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
